title: galium japonicum var. trifloriforme
intro: Galium japonicum var. trifloriforme, commonly known as Japanese Galium, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and promoting relaxation due to its soothing effects. The therapeutic actions of Japanese Galium include its use as a mild sedative, an anti-inflammatory, and a digestive aid, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Japanese Galium, including galionic acid and other flavonoids, contribute to its medicinal properties.
